name: Tail Saga : The Princess Apprentice
source:
Your name is Alexandra, an outsider to the small Kingdom of Odamant. You are what people call a Magus, able to wield and manipulate mana to cast magic. You've worked as a freelancer in the city for months, until one day you receive a letter addressed to you. A summons from the King...

[From [url=https://overclock.itch.io/tail-saga-the-princess-apprentice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的名字叫亚历山德拉，是小国奥达曼特的一名外来者。你是人们口中的魔导士，能够掌控并操纵魔力来施展魔法。你在城里当了好几个月的自由职业者，直到某一天，你收到了一封寄给你的信——一道来自国王的召令……

[引自[url=https://overclock.itch.io/tail-saga-the-princess-apprentice]Itch.io[/url]]
